pr_title: fix: add await to inventory fetch in checkout flow
pr_body:
## Problem
Race condition in checkout flow causing `TypeError: Cannot read property 'quantity' of undefined` during high-concurrency scenarios.

## Root Cause
The `decrementInventory` function was calling `getInventory()` without awaiting the Promise, leading to undefined access when trying to read the `quantity` property.

## Solution
- Added `await` keyword before `getInventory()` call
- Improved error message to include available and requested quantities
- Added test cases for concurrent checkout scenarios

## Testing
- Added unit tests for race condition scenarios
- Tested with 10 concurrent checkout requests
- Verified error handling for insufficient stock

## Impact
- Fixes production issue affecting checkout service
- No breaking changes
- Improves error messages for better debugging

## Checklist
- [x] Code follows project style guidelines
- [x] Tests added and passing
- [x] Error handling improved
- [x] No breaking changes
